Noting the need to prohibit the transfer of small arms, light weapons, and ammunition to non-state actors engaged in 
or supporting gang violence, criminal activities, or human rights abuses in Haiti, as well as to prevent their illicit 
trafficking and diversion, 


Encouraging cooperation between Member States to prevent illicit arms trafficking and diversion, including through 
providing and exchanging timely and up to date information in order to identify and combat illicit trafficking sources 
and supply chains, 


Acknowledging the urgent need to address the illicit financial flows to Haiti enabling armed gangs to operate and 
posing a growing threat to the country’s stability, including by prioritizing breaking links between political and 
economic actors and gangs, 


Expressing concerns about the Haitian National Police’s lack of access to vital ports which are largely under the 
control of gangs, and further demanding to stop the illegal occupation of ports and fuel terminals by gangs, 


Welcoming the launch of technical programmes by the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) to assist 
national authorities to promote border and ports control, trace illicit financial flows, collaborate across borders _ to 
combat transnational crime, corruption, and drug and arms trafficking, including through the UNODC- World Customs 
Organization (WCO) Container Control Programme in Haiti and border management programmes, and further 
welcoming the Caribbean Community’s (CARICOM) regional roadmap to combat the trafficking of firearms, 


Recognizing the important role of neighboring countries, regional and subregional organizations such as CARICOM, 
and other international partners, 


Expressing deep concern at the persistent and destabilizing criminal activities perpetrated by armed gangs in Haiti and 
the unabated transfer of small arms, light weapons, and ammunition to actors engaged in or supporting gang violence, 


Condemning attacks and kidnappings of UN personnel, violence against diplomatic premises, and the looting of 
humanitarian aid, and recalling that the primary responsibility for the safety and security of United Nations personnel 
and assets rests with the host state, 


Calling upon all actors in Haiti to issue clear orders prohibiting all human rights violations and abuses, and 
underscoring the necessity for all actors to ensure immediate, safe and unhindered access by humanitarian 
organizations, 


Stressing that the measures imposed by this resolution are not intended to have adverse humanitarian consequences for 
the civilian population of Haiti, 


Recognizing the need to ensure that fair and clear procedures exist for delisting individuals, groups, undertakings, and 
entities designated pursuant to this resolution and expressing its intent to consider authorizing the Ombudsperson to 
receive such delisting requests, 


Determining that the situation in Haiti continues to constitute a threat to international peace and security in the region, 
Acting under Chapter VII of the Charter of the United Nations,

का.आ. 455(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 2303 तारीख 25/05/2023, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग Il, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (ii) F प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा बिहार राज्य के कैमूर (भभुआ) जिले में ग्रीनफील्ड 
हाईवे (एन. एच. 319 बी )के कि.मी. 22+000 से कि.मी.74+000 तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चोड़ा करने / चार 
/(छ: लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि 
का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "29/06/2023 " 
को "दैनिक जागरण" और " टाइम्स ऑफ इंडिया" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया 
है; 

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है;

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 2nd February, 2024 


S.O. 455(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, 2303 Dated:25/05/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section 
(ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to 
as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed 
to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of Greenfield Highway(NH-319B) in the stretch of land from Km. 22+000 to Km. 74+000 ( in the district of 
KAIMUR (BHABUA ) in the state of BIHAR 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Dainik Jagran” and “Times of 
India" both dated 29/06/2023 under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

DRAFT RULES 


Short title and commencement. — (l) These rules may be called the Anusandhan National Research 
Foundation (qualifications, experience, salary, allowances, and other terms and conditions of service of Chief 
Executive Officer) Rules, 2023. 


(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 
Definitions. — () In these rules, unless the context otherwise requires, — 
(a) ‘Act’ means the Anusandhan National Research Foundation Act, 2023 (25 of 2023); 


(b) “President” means a president of the Governing Board referred to in clause (a) of sub-section (2) of 
section 5 of the Act; 


(2) Words and expressions used and not defined in these rules but defined in the Act shall have the same 
meanings as assigned to them in the Act. 


Procedure for selection of Chief Executive Officer. — (l) The President shall select and appoint the Chief 
Executive Officer based on the qualifications set forth under these rules. 


(2) The President may, if he considers necessary, constitute a Search-cum-Selection Committee and make a 
reference to such Committee for recommendation of a panel of names for appointment of the Chief Executive 
Officer. 


(3) The Search-cum-Selection Committee shall be chaired by an eminent person as nominated by the President, 
and shall comprise of the following Members, namely : — 


(a) Principal Scientific Advisor to the Government of India; 
(b) Secretary to the Government of India in the Department of Science and Technology; 
(c) Secretary to the Government of India in the Department of Higher Education; and 


(d) A Member of the Governing Board from business organisation or industry as nominated by the 
President. 


(4) The Search-cum-Selection Committee shall devise its own procedure for selecting the persons for inclusion 
in the panel of names to be recommended as the Chief Executive Officer. 


(5) The Search-cum-Selection Committee shall make its recommendations for inclusion in the panel of names to 
be recommended as the Chief Executive Officer, to the President within a period not exceeding sixty days, from 
the date of reference made under sub-rule (2). 


Qualifications and Experience of Chief Executive Officer. — (/) A person being considered for appointment 


as Chief Executive Officer shall possess — 


(a) amnasters’ degree in science, or a bachelor’s degree in engineering or medicine, or a masters’ degree in 
management, with proven track record of research, or innovation, or technology development; and 


(b) at least twenty years of experience as faculty or scientist in recognised national or international 
university, or research institution, or research laboratory of the Government or a company or at a senior 
managerial level in a company, including five years of experience in managing research and 
development programmes or projects. 


(2) A person considered for appointment under sub-rule () shall not exceed sixty five years of age. 


Term of office of Chief Executive Officer. — The Chief Executive Officer of the Foundation shall hold office 
for a period of three years from the date of appointment, or such other period as determined by the President, and 
shall be eligible for reappointment: 


Provided that no person above the age of seventy years shall occupy the office of the Chief Executive 
Officer, unless otherwise determined by the President. 


Conditions of Service of Chief Executive Officer. — The Chief Executive Officer shall be paid a salary and 
allowances of such amount, as may be determined by the President, and shall also be eligible for benefits under 
rules 9 and 0.

employees of the Central Government and the payment of salary during leave shall be governed by rule 40 of the

eligible for allotment of Central Government Residential Accommodation in the general pool on the same terms 
as are admissible to Central Government servants. 


(2) In the event, the Chief Executive Officer of the Foundation who is not allotted accommodation under sub- 
rule (L), he shall be eligible for House Rent Allowance as determined by the Governing Board. 


Entitlement to Central Government Health Scheme. — The Chief Executive Officer of the Foundation shall 
be entitled to the benefits of the Central Government Health Scheme on terms laid down by the Central 
Government of India in this behalf. 


Traveling and daily allowances. — The Chief Executive Officer, while on tour within India or on transfer, 
including the journey undertaken to join the Foundation or on the completion of their tenure with the Foundation 
to proceed to their home town, shall be entitled to the travelling allowance, daily allowance transportation of 
personal effects and other similar matters at the rate applicable to a Secretary to the Government of India. 


Official visits abroad. — Official visits abroad by the Chief Executive Officer, shall be undertaken with 
approval of the Secretary, Department of Science and Technology, and shall be regulated as per the guidelines or 
instructions issued by the Central Government from time to time. 


Matters with respect to which no provision has been made. — Matters relating to the terms and conditions of 
service of the Chief Executive Officer of the Foundation, with respect to which no express provision has been 
made in these rules, shall be referred by the Executive Council to the Central Government for its decision. 


Power to relax. — Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient to do so, it 
may, by order for reasons to be recorded in writing, relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to the 
Chief Executive Officer of the Foundation. 


Interpretation. — If any queries relating to the implementation of these rules arise, they shall be decided by the 
Governing Board. 


Removal of difficulties. — The Executive Council may from time to time issue such general or specific 
directions as may be necessary to remove difficulties in the operation of any of the provisions of these rules.

Highways, S.O. 4536 (E) Dated the l6th October 2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, 
Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for the public purpose of building (widening/six/eight laning, etc.), 
maintenance, management and operation of Mumbai - Vadodara Expressway Spur to NH-NE4 in the stretch of land 
from Km. |8.925 to Km. 45.400 (Maharashtra Section) in the district of Thane in the state of Maharashtra. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Lokmat”(Marathi) and “The Free 
Press Journal” (English) both dated 30th November 2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 2nd February, 2024 


9.0. 473(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, S.O No.1229(E), dated on 14th March, 2023, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, 
Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land 
"Rehabilitation and Up-gradation of Nehrunagar — Kothagudem Section of NH-930P from Km.189.600 to km.196.460 
(Revenue Division Office, Khammam) in the district of Khammam in the state of Telangana”. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Hindu”(English) and 
“Namasthe Telangana”(Telugu) both dated 15 April 2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 472(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ.1106(ए) दिनाँक 9 मार्च, 2023, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग ॥, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (ii गई (इसके बाद बाद में उक्त अधिनियम के रूप में संदर्भित), केंद्र सरकार ने 
मिर्यालागुडा टाउन सीमा) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 के 48) की धारा 3 ए की 
उप-धारा (1) के तहत जारी की में मौजूदा सड़क के दोनों ओर 184.950 से 185.950 तक की भूमि का अधिग्रहण करने 
की अपनी मंशा की घोषणा की, "किमी.182+570 से किमी.187+723 तक सुधार और चौड़ीकरण सहित एसएच-2 तक 
320 मीटर लिंक रोड" तेलंगाना राज्य में नालगोंडा जिले में मिर्यालगुडा शहर (रेवेन्यु डिविजनल ऑफ़िस, मिर्यालगुडा) की 
नगरपालिका सीमा में NH-167 के किमी.185+230 से 185+920 तक सड़क का निर्माण” 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "14 अप्रैल 2023" 
को "नमस्ते तेलंगाना"(तेलुगु) और "द हिन्दू" (अंग्रेजी) दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को 
अपनी रिपोर्ट दे दी है ; 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी |

New Delhi, the 2nd February, 2024 


9.0. 472(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, S.O No.1106(E), dated on 09 March 2023, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part वी, 
Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land from stretch 
184.950 to 185.950 on either side of existing Road in Miryalaguda Town limits of “Improvements from 
Km.182+570 to Km.187+723 and 320m link road to SH-2 including widening of road from Km.185+230 to 
185+920 of NH-167 in the Municipal Limits of Miryalaguda town in the (Revenue Division Office, 
Miryalaguda) in the district of Nalgonda in the State of Telangana”. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Namaste Telangana 
(Telugu)” and “The Hindu (English)” both dated 14 April 2023 under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose;

And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

S.O. 47(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and

specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for construction of Toll Plaza Maintenance, management

Telangana” both dated ]4th March 2023 and 03rd November 2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said 
Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government;

conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose;

declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

New Delhi, the 2nd February, 2024 


S.O. 470(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH548E in

the stretch of land from Km. 98.65 to Km. 141.600 (deputy collector land acquisition 11, central Buildings, First 
Floor, A section, Solapur) in the district of SOLAPUR in the state of MAHARASHTRA, hereby declares its intention 
to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Dy collector and LAO Solapur 
11 in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity 
of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making 
such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the 
objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be

का.आ. 443(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 3642 (अ),दिनांक: - 14.08.2023, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग ॥, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा आंध्र प्रदेश राज्य के वाई एस आर कडपा जिले में 
कि.मी. 75.000 से कि.मी. 199.000 तक नया प्रस्तावित बैंगलोर - मायडाकुरु (कडपा) - अमरवती/ विजयवाड़ा ग्रीन 
फील्ड आर्थिक गलियारा निर्माण (4-लेन/6-लेन का बनाना आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना 
से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "05.11.2023 " 
को "प्रजा शक्ति" और "दा हंस इंडिया" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है; 

अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 

और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 2nd February, 2024 


S.O. 443(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, S.O. 3642 (E) Dated:- 14.08.2023, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, 
Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building of four/six laning of Newly proposed Bangalore - Mydakuru 
(Kadapa) - Amarvathi/Vijayawada Greenfield Corridor in the stretch of land from Km. 75.000 to Km. 199.000 in the 
district of Y. S. R. Kadapa in the state of ANDHRA PRADESH. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Prajasakti” and “The Hans India” 
both dated 05.11.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 2470(E) तारीख 06/06/2023, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग I, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा उड़ीसा राज्य के जाजपुर जिले में NH-20 के 
कि.मी. 0.000 से कि.मी. 1.200 (माधोपुर-बड़ाबंता खंड) तक के भूखण्ड पर निर्माण, अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के 
लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "२९,०७.२०२३ 
एवं ३०.०७.२०२३ " को "प्रगतिबादी " और "प्रमेय" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है ;

पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ;

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 2nd Febuary, 2024 


S.O. 439(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 2470(E) Dated:06/06/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part I, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for construction, Maintenance, management and operation of NH20 in the stretch of 
land from km 0.000 to km 1.200 (Madhopur-Badabanta Section) in the district of Jajpur in the state of ODISHA. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Pragatibadi” and “Prameya” 
both dated 29.07.2023 and 30.07.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 2nd Febuary, 2024 


S.O. 428(E).— In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH37 in the 
stretch of land from Km. Km. 4.560 to Km. 24.560 in the district of CACHAR in the state of ASSAM, hereby 
declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Additional Deputy 
Commissioner in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and 
after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or 
disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

MINISTRY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY 
(Department of Science and Technology) 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 2nd February, 2024 


G.S.R. 88(E).—The following draft rules which the Central Government proposes to make in exercise of the 
powers conferred by clauses (g) and (h) of sub-section (2) of Section 23 of the Anusandhan National Research 
Foundation Act, 2023 (25 of 2023), are hereby published for the information of all persons likely to be affected 
thereby, and notice is hereby given that the said notification will be taken into consideration on or after the expiry of a 
period of thirty (30) days from the date of publication of the draft in the official Gazette; 


Objections or suggestions, if any, may be addressed to the Senior Adviser, Department of Science and 
Technology, Government of India, Technology Bhawan, New Delhi — 110016 or by e-mail at akhilesh.g@nic.in and 
praveen @nic.in; 


The objections and suggestions, which may be received from any person with respect to the said draft rules 
before the expiry of the period so specified, will be considered by the Central Government. 


DRAFT RULES 


1. Short title and commencement. — (1) These rules may be called the Anusandhan National Research 
Foundation (budget and annual report) Rules, 2023. 


(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 
2. Definitions. — (1) In these rules, unless the context otherwise requires, — 
a) ‘Act’ means the Anusandhan National Research Foundation Act, 2023 (25 of 2023); 
b) ‘annual report’ means the annual report prepared by the Executive Council under section 15 of the Act; 
C) ‘budget’ means the budget prepared by Executive Council under section 14 of the Act; 
d) ‘Form’ means the forms annexed to these rules; 


९) ‘Schedule’ means the schedule annexed to these rules; 


(2) Words and expressions used and not defined in these rules but defined in the Act shall have the same 
meanings as assigned to them in the Act. 


3. Form for preparation of budget. — The Executive Council shall prepare the budget, as approved by the 
Governing Board, for the next financial year in Form -‘A’ specified in the Schedule appended to these rules and 
shall submit the same to the Central Government by 317 October of every year. 


4. Preparation and furnishing of the annual report. — (1) The Executive Council shall prepare once in every 
year an annual report and submit a copy of the same to the Central Government, giving a true and full account of 
the Foundation’s activities during the previous financial year in Form -‘B’ specified in the Schedule, appended to 
these rules. 


(1) The Executive Council may also include in the annual report any other item, not included in Form-‘B’ 
specified in the Schedule, if so required to give a full account of the Foundation’s activities.

(2) The Executive Council, shall forward the annual report to the Central Government within a period of one 
hundred and eighty days immediately following the close of the year for which it has been prepared. 


Matters with respect to which no provision has been made. — The matters relating to form and time of annual 
report, with respect to which no express provision has been made in these rules, shall be referred in each case to 
the Central Government for its decision.

9. प्रतिष्ठान प्रशासन- विज्ञान और प्रौद्योगिकी विभाग, विज्ञान और प्रौद्योगिकी मंत्रालय प्रतिष्ठान का प्रशासनिक मंत्रालय 
होगा। 

10. ऐसे विषय जिनके संबंध में कोई उपबंध नहीं किया गया है - शासी बोर्ड के सदस्यों और कार्य परिषद के सदस्यों की 
सेवा के निबन्धन और शर्त संबंधी मामले, जिनके लिए इन नियमों में कोई स्पष्ट उपबंध नहीं किया गया है, केन्द्रीय 
सरकार के विनिश्चयनार्थ अग्रेषित किए जाएँगे। 


11. शिथिलन शक्ति-जहाँ केन्द्रीय सरकार का मत है कि जहां ऐसा करना आवश्यक या समीचीन है वहाँ वह, लिखित में दर्ज 
किए जाने वाले कारणों से आदेश द्वारा, शासी बोर्ड के सदस्यों और कार्य परिषद के सदस्यों के संबंध में इस नियमावली 
के उपबंधों में से किसी उपबंध में छूट दे सकेगी।

MINISTRY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY 
(Department of Science and Technology) 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 2nd February, 2024 


G.S.R. 85(E).—The following draft rules which the Central Government proposes to make in exercise of the 
powers conferred by clauses (a) and (b) of sub-section (2) of Section 23 of the Anusandhan National Research 
Foundation Act, 2023 (25 of 2023), are hereby published for the information of all persons likely to be affected 
thereby, and notice is hereby given that the said notification will be taken into consideration on or after the expiry of a 
period of thirty (30) days from the date of publication of the draft in the official Gazette; 


Objections or suggestions, if any, may be addressed to the Senior Adviser, Department of Science and 
Technology, Government of India, Technology Bhawan, New Delhi — 110016 or by e-mail at akhilesh.g@nic.in and 
praveen @nic.in; 


The objections and suggestions, which may be received from any person with respect to the said draft rules 
before the expiry of the period so specified, will be considered by the Central Government. 


DRAFT RULES 


1. Short title and commencement. — (1) These rules may be called the Anusandhan National Research 
Foundation (qualifications, experience, honorarium, allowances, and other terms and conditions of service of 
Members of the Governing Board and Executive Council) Rules, 2023. 


(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 
2. Definitions. — (1) In these rules, unless the context otherwise requires, — 
(a) ‘Act’ means the Anusandhan National Research Foundation Act, 2023 (25 of 2023); 


(b) “President” means a president of the Governing Board referred to in clause (a) of sub-section 
(2) of section 5 of the Act; 


(2) Words and expressions used and not defined in these rules but defined in the Act shall have the same 
meanings as assigned to them in the Act.

3. Qualifications and experience of Members of Governing Board. — (1) The Members to be nominated or 
appointed under clause (a) of sub-section (3) of section 5 of the Act shall be Members of the Prime Minister’s 
Science, Technology and Innovation Council. 


(2) The Members to be nominated or appointed under clause (b) of sub-section 3 of section 5 of the Act shall 
be a person who has previously occupied or currently occupies a position of leadership at a business 
organisation or an industry. 


(3) The Member to be nominated or appointed under clause (c) of sub-section 3 of section 5 of the Act shall 
possess minimum period of ten years of experience in the field of humanities and social sciences. 


(4) The Members to be nominated or appointed under clause (d) of sub-section 3 of section 5 of the Act shall 
hold the position of head of a national laboratory or research/academic institution engaged in scientific and 
technological research and development, or senior scientist or senior faculty member in such institution 
with a minimum period of twenty years of experience. 


(5) The Members to be nominated or appointed under clause (e) of sub-section 3 of section 5 of the Act shall 
possess a doctorate degree or other specialised educational qualification in one or more of the following 
fields, — 


(i) health; 
(ii) | mathematical and physical sciences; 
Gi) biological sciences; 
(iv) engineering and technology; 
(v) innovation and partnership; 
(vi) | computer and information sciences; 
(vii) engineering, 
and shall have minimum period of twenty years of experience in the field. 


4. Term of office of Members of Governing Board. — The Members of the Governing Board shall ordinarily 
hold office for a period of three years from the date of appointment, or such other period as determined by the 
President, and shall be eligible for reappointment. 


5... Allowances for Members of the Governing Board appointed. — (1) Every Member of the Governing Board 
appointed under sub-clause (3) of section 5 of the Act, attending the meeting of the Governing Board, shall be 
entitled to allowances and expenses in accordance with the following:— 


(a) Where a Member is required to undertake outstation travel for the purpose of attending a meeting of the 
Governing Board, or for performing the functions of the Governing Board, such Member shall be 
entitled to — 


(i) air fare by the highest class available; 


(ii) accommodation expenses at actuals, subject to ceiling amounts as may be approved by the 
Governing Board from time to time; and 


(iii) all other aspects of such travel shall be regulated as per the guidelines or instructions as may be 
approved by the Governing Board from time to time.

Where a Member of the Governing Board is a resident at a place where the meeting of the Governing 
Board is held, or where any other business of the Governing Board is transacted, shall be paid the actual 
expenditure incurred on conveyance by him, from the usual place of office or residence of Member of 
the Governing Board to the place of the meeting where such Member has gone to attend any business of 
the Governing Board and back to his place of office or residence: 


Provided that when the journey commences from or the return journey terminates at any other 
place, the travelling allowances shall be restricted to the amount that would have been payable had the 
journey commenced from or terminated at the usual place of office or residence, or to the amount 
payable in respect of the actual journey undertaken, whichever is less: 


Provided further that in special circumstances, the President may grant travelling allowance 
from places other than the usual place of office or residence of a member. 


(c) No travelling allowance or daily allowance shall be allowed to a Member of the Governing Board unless 
he certifies that he has not drawn any travelling or daily allowance from any other source in respect of 
the journey and halt for which the claim is made.

(2) No additional amount of payment, including pension and gratuity, shall be admissible to any Member of the

6. Qualification and experience of Members of Executive Council. — The Members to be nominated or 
appointed under clause (b) of sub-section 3 of section 7 of the Act shall — 


(a) possess doctorate degree or other specialised qualification in the fields of science and technology in 


(b) 


academia, philanthropic sector, research laboratories and industries; and 


have minimum period of fifteen years of experience in the field. 


7. Term of office of Members of Executive Council. — The Members of the Executive Council shall, ordinarily 
hold office for a period of three years, or such other period as determined by the President, from the date of 
appointment and be eligible for reappointment. 


8. Allowances for Members of Executive Council. — (1) Every Member of the Executive Council appointed 
under clause (b) of sub-section (3) of section 7 of the Act, attending the meeting of the Executive Council, shall 
be entitled to allowances and expenses in accordance with the following:—

A member of the Executive Council, other than a Government servant, shall be entitled to draw sitting 
allowances, travelling allowances, daily allowances, and such other allowances at the highest rates as 
admissible to the officials of the Central Government for the time being in force, in respect of any 
journey performed by him for the purpose of attending a meeting or for the purpose of discharging any 
duty assigned to him by the Executive Council. 


A member of the Executive Council who is a resident at a place where the meeting of the Executive 
Council is held or where any other business of the Executive Council is transacted, shall be paid the 
actual expenditure incurred on conveyance by him, from the usual place of office or residence of 
member of the Executive Council to the place of the meeting where such Member has gone to attend any 
business of the Executive Council and back to his or her place of office or residence: 


Provided that when the journey commences from or the return journey terminates at any other 
place, the travelling allowances shall be restricted to the amount that would have been payable had the 
journey commenced from or terminated at the usual place of office or residence, or to the amount 
payable in respect of the actual journey undertaken, whichever is less: 


Provided further that in special circumstances, the Chairperson or the Member Secretary, may 
grant travelling allowance from places other than the usual place of office or residence of a member. 


No travelling allowance or daily allowance shall be allowed to a member of the Executive Council 
unless he certifies that he has not drawn any travelling or daily allowance from any other source in 
respect of the journey and halt for which the claim is made. 


(2) No additional amount of payment, including pension and gratuity shall be admissible to any Member of the 
Executive Council for service rendered by him to the Executive Council. 


9. Administration of Foundation. — The Department of Science and Technology, Ministry of Science and 
Technology shall be the administrative Ministry for the Foundation. 


10, Matters with respect to which no provision has been made. — Matters relating to the terms and conditions of 
service of the Members of the Governing Board and Members of the Executive Council, with respect to which 
no express provision has been made in these rules, shall be referred to the Central Government for its decision. 


11. Power to relax. — Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so to do, it 
may, by order for reasons to be recorded in writing, relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to the 
Members of the Governing Board and Members of the Executive Council.

परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 4487 तारीख 12/10/2023, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग II, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा तमिलनाडु राज्य के नागपटनम जिले में NH45A 
के कि.मी. 123.8 से कि.मी.179.555 (स्पेशल डिस्ट्रिक्ट रेवेनुए अफसर (ला -नह ) , ४५अ , कलेक्टर ऑफिस , 
नागपट्टिनम) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चोड़ाकरने / चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन 
के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "a हिंदू" को 
"दीनथनादि" और "17 नवंबर 2023" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है;

का.आ. 457(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 5.0.4428 (८) तारीख 10/10/2023, जो भारत के 
राजपत्र, असाधारण, भाग Il, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा असम राज्य के कारबी आंगलोंग जिले में 
NH29 के कि.मी. 113+830 से कि.मी.145+712 (कारबी आंगलोंग ऑटोनोमस कौंसिल डिपार्टमेंट ऑफ़ राजस्व, दिफू) 
तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चोड़ाकरने / चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस 
अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख 28 अक्टूबर, 
2023 और 10 नवंबर, 2023 को ”द थेकर” और "a असम ट्रिब्यून” दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है;

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 2nd February, 2024 

9.0. 457(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, S.0.4428 (E) Dated:10/10/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (1) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of NH29 in the stretch of land from Km. 113+830 to Km. 145+712 (Karbi Anglong Autonomous Council Department 
of Revenue, Diphu) in the district of KARBI ANGLONG in the state of ASSAM 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Thekar” and “The Assam 
Tribune” both dated 28.10.2023 & 10.11.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 


specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 


vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 461(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 1994(E) तारीख 01/05/2023, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग 1, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा कर्नाटक राज्य के शिवमोग्गा जिले में एनएच 69 
(पुराना एनएच 206) के किमी 220.00 (नई चेनेज किमी. 119.637) से किमी. 238.100 (नई चेनेज किमी 148.088) 
(होब्लावर-चित्तूर खंड) के निर्माण (चौड़ीकरण/पेव्ड शोल्डर सहित 2-लेन/4-लेन का बनाना आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और 
प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "19/07/2023 " 
को "डेक्कन हेराल्ड" और "होसाडिगंथा" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 


724 GI/2024 (1)

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है; 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 

और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

कर्नाटक राज्य के शिवमोग्गा जिले में एनएच 69 (पुराना एनएच 206) के किमी. 220.00 (नई चेनेज किमी 119.637) से 
किमी. 238.100 (नई चेनेज किमी 148.088) (होन्नावर-चित्तूर खंड) के लिए अर्जन की जाने वाली संरचना रहित अथवा 
संरचना सहित भूमि का संक्षिप्त विवरण।

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 2nd February, 2024 


9.0. 461(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, 1991(E) Dated:01/05/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (1) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification building (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,),Maintenance, 
management and operation of NH69(Old NH 206) in the stretch of land from Km 220.00 (New chainage Km 119.637) 
to Km 238.100 (New chainage Km 148.088) (Honnavar - Chittoor Section) in the district of SHIVAMOGGA in the 
state of KARNATAKA 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Deccan Herald” and 
“Hosadigantha” both dated 19/07/2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and settled 
the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to 
acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/two/four-laning, 
etc.), Maintenance, management and operation of NH543 in the stretch of land from K.m. 0+000 to 79+880 K.m. 
(Shahdol to Sagartola -Road) (Kachharatola Bypass) in the District - ANUPPUR in the state of MADHYA 
PRADESH.

“Dainik Kirti Kranti (English)” both dated 5 December 2023; & “Dainik Bhaskar (Hindi)” and “The 
Hitavada (English)” both dated 20 July 2023 ; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


Or

And where as, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, there fore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government here by declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.
